assumptions: Circular concentric full tori are idealized geometry, with no resolved ports, divertor, coolant channels, coil packs, or supports.
All layer dimensions, the 1.0 m plasma minor radius, clearance, and the 30-year horizon are authored scaffold assumptions.
Material identifiers ending in unassigned have no density, composition, temperature, or evaluated nuclear data attached.
The magnet layer is a geometric envelope, not a resolved superconducting magnet design.
The viewer cutaway removes a sector for display only; manifest volumes describe the complete torus.
No breeding ratio, exposure, activation, service limit, lifetime, or electricity result has been calculated.
Cold-data reference uses physical material temperature unspecified (None); nuclear data target 293.6 K and nearest library temperature match must be within 0.1 K.

Elemental and compound densities/compositions are authored or literature-derived surrogates; no material is asserted to represent hot liquid blanket, Inconel vessel, packed TiH2 shield, or superconducting magnet.
Neutron-only transport responses are per source neutron; no local deposited-heat response or plant electricity claim.
